domain_hint: Mounting bracket FEA for avionics box under random vibration and modal requirements
ambiguity_notes:
- Numerical convergence/mesh behavior: slide claims <2% change yet backup shows ~7% at a hotspot using a different solver
- Input data pedigree/material properties: E listed as 114 GPa in one place and 110 GPa in another; yield strength 880 vs 930 MPa
- Loads and boundary conditions: environment specified as 9.0 g RMS but one model run uses 7.5 g; damping alternates between 1.0% and 1.5%
- Validation vs test: summary says modes within 10%, but the 3rd mode deviates by ~12%
- Software provenance/configuration control: primary tool Ansys 2023R2, yet some results come from Abaqus 6.14; production deck not from a tagged commit
- Geometry fidelity: early statement “all fillets retained” conflicts with images indicating suppression of <1 mm fillets
